plan.summary: This 1-4 block is a simple off-camp boxing build with one weekly full-body session using bodyweight-only work. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body strength pattern with a hard rep test so future work can be compared, and the main training starts in Week 2. The focus for this block is clean movement, basic strength, explosive intent, and enough trunk and upper-body work to support punching and clinch control without adding unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic full-body strength and simple explosive qualities with clean bodyweight progressions.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Make the main patterns harder through tougher variations, stronger positions, and slightly denser work.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength while shifting more of the work toward crisp speed, snap, and repeatable power.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can with a quiet landing. Reset between reps so every jump stays fast.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if space is limited. Start from a still quarter squat and jump hard.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Use a variation that lets you keep 1-2 reps in reserve on every set. Keep the body straight and pause briefly at the bottom.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your hardest clean set at the chosen variation this week.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use hands on a bench, box, or sturdy surface if floor push-ups are too hard.

substitutionOptions.name: Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you still need an easier option to keep full range and good body position.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.notes: This is your baseline test for lower-body strength endurance. Warm up with a few easy practice sets, then do one hard top set per side and stop when form breaks or you would miss the next rep.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then perform one hard top set per side with bodyweight only. Log the reps on each side so the app can set your baseline for future progress.

substitutionOptions.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if you already perform these confidently and can keep balance under control.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.notes: Pull your chest to the bar or table edge with a straight body. Stop with 1-2 reps in reserve and keep each rep clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Doorway Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a very sturdy setup only. Keep tension even and avoid jerking.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if you have a secure anchor and can keep the setup safe.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.notes: Keep a straight line from head to heel and do not let the hips sag.

substitutionOptions.name: Front Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if side planks irritate the shoulder.

exercises.name: Shadowboxing Speed Burst
exercises.notes: Stay sharp, relaxed, and fast. Do not turn this into conditioning.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump high and land softly. Stop early if height drops off.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if space is limited. Keep the pause short and explode up.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Use a variation that leaves 1-2 reps in reserve. Drive up fast while keeping the torso stiff.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your best clean set at the same variation or a harder one if you earned it.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Raise the hands if needed to stay in the target rep range.

substitutionOptions.name: Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if needed to keep full range and smooth reps.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.notes: Control the way down, push hard out of the bottom, and keep the front foot flat.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the hardest clean set per side and note if balance or leg strength limited you.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if split squats feel awkward. Step back under control and keep the torso tall.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.notes: Pull to the same position every rep. Keep 1-2 reps in reserve and avoid shrugging up.

substitutionOptions.name: Doorway Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Only use a secure setup and keep the movement smooth.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Keep the low back gently pressed down and ribs tucked.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug

exercises.name: Shadowboxing Speed Burst

exercises.name: Squat Jump
exercises.notes: Start from a still quarter squat and explode up. Land quietly and reset each rep.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up

substitutionOptions.name: Side Plank

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
